We have IR spectrum data. Need number of carbonyl (C=O) groups. Carbonyl shows strong absorption around 1700 cm-1 (typically 1650-1750). The IR data list includes wavenumbers: 3357, 3091, 3078, 3062, 3060, 3043, 3039, 3033, 3027, 3025, 3024, 3021, 3002, 3001, 2998, 2993, 2966, 2957, 2949, 2942, 2878, 1606, 1587. No peak near 1700. The only peaks in 1600-1700 region are 1606 and 1587, which are aromatic C=C or maybe conjugated carbonyl but not typical carbonyl. So likely zero carbonyl groups.

Thus answer integer 0.

Check if any other data needed? Could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbon ~200 ppm. But IR already suggests none. To be safe, maybe check carbon NMR for carbonyl signals. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool.
